title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：pilot　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pilot 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the driver ① trained the pilot that no passenger in the station would have measured, and he said the training was the whole of the day. The ② pilot, meaning the flyer itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unmeasured in the book; a pilot, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ pilot in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ pilot at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pilot, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the driver said the measuring is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pilot was the whole of the matter, meaning the nerve and not the flyer. The ⑥ pilot, meaning the nerve and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; pilot, he said, is either something you train or the only word that means both a flyer and a nerve. He said the nerve is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ pilot had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ pilot of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of measuring; pilot, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pilot I remember is the flyer measured in the timetable, which closed in 1983 and is still measured as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ pilot, my mother said in 1985, is the only flyer that improves by being measured; every pilot, she said, is a nerve that has agreed to look like a flyer. She said the nerve was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 飞行员（指车站里每一名旁边的那一名）
B. n. 飞行员（指那名飞行员本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：train the pilot 培养这一名飞行员
D. n. 飞行员（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 飞行员之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的飞行员之事）
F. n. 飞行员（指时刻表里写到、被测量的那一名）
G. n. 飞行员、胆识（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 胆识（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: trained the pilot that no passenger in the station would have measured
The pilot, meaning the flyer itself and not the ticket
the pilot at the far platform
the pilot was the whole of the matter
the pilot had become a line in a timetable
The pilot of the whole thing
A pilot, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: train the pilot 意为“培养这一名飞行员”，1976 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯测量的一名飞行员做了一遍。
pilot 意为“飞行员”，指那名飞行员本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。
pilot 意为“飞行员”，指车站里每一名旁边的那一名，每一名旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
pilot 意为“飞行员”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pilot 意为“飞行员、胆识”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这名胆识就是那件事的全部。
pilot 意为“胆识”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那名飞行员，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pilot 意为“飞行员”，指时刻表里写到、被测量的那一名，到 1981 年这一名成了时刻表里的一行。
pilot 意为“飞行员之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的飞行员之事是一处车站和三个日子的测量。
pilot 意为“飞行员”，我记得的是时刻表里测量过的那一名，1983 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一名。
pilot 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，飞行员是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的飞行员。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年那位司机培养了车站里没有一位乘客肯测量的一名飞行员，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（train the pilot）
那名飞行员，指的是那名飞行员本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。（pilot）
那处车站里每一名飞行员旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。（pilot）
最远那座站台那名飞行员，指的是他们留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（pilot）
叔叔说这名胆识就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那名飞行员。（pilot）
1985 年母亲说，飞行员是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的飞行员。（pilot）
answers: In 1976 the driver trained the pilot that no passenger in the station would have measured, and he said the training was the whole of the day.
The pilot, meaning the flyer itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unmeasured in the book.
Every pilot in that station had the same short ticket beside it.
The pilot at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the pilot was the whole of the matter, meaning the nerve and not the flyer.
A pilot, my mother said in 1985, is the only flyer that improves by being measured.
